verdict.rationale: Codegen supports some automatic event-driven actions—triggering agents from CI/CD pipeline failures, automatic PR review that posts comments on failing checks, and agents responding only to explicit mentions—showing a degree of rule/event-based automation. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose rule-definition interface where users can author arbitrary 'if event X then action Y' automations; the examples are fixed integration behaviors rather than a configurable rules engine. Missing for 10: a documented general rules/trigger framework letting users define custom event-condition-action logic, and evidence of user-authored trigger configuration beyond built-in integrations.
